_about: Allowlists for tools/check/check.py. Keep them short; every entry is an exception someone has to justify. App paths only (the frozen poc/ is checked by java / secrets / large / images only). Every cleartext_ok / network_ok entry has its reason. permissions / queries: the release APK's exact uses-permission list and <queries> entries (package:<name>, intent:<action>), each with the reason; ManifestTest (merged manifest) and tools/release/verify-apk.sh (the APK) fail on any difference. prerelease_ok: every alpha / beta / rc library in apps/android/gradle/libs.versions.toml, its exact version and why no stable one will do; android-release.sh prints them for the release notes.

cleartext_ok.reason: local Juggluco on this phone: its web server listens on loopback only (127.0.0.1:17580); nothing leaves the device

Nightscout upload site rules: a typed http:// address is accepted only for this phone's loopback (localhost / 127.x / ::1), all network_security_config allows; any other http:// is refused with 'use https://'
Nightscout API on this phone: the loopback address apps on this phone use, shown as text for copying (the server binds 127.0.0.1 only); nothing is opened
Nightscout API on this phone: the loopback address with the token, shown as text for copying (the server binds 127.0.0.1 only); nothing is opened

Nightscout API on the home Wi-Fi (opt-in, warned as unencrypted): the address other devices on this Wi-Fi use, with the Wi-Fi secret only (never the phone apps' secret), shown as text for copying; the app opens nothing

Mac Juggluco on this network (opt-in switch, off by default; Settings says it is plain http): built only from a LanAddress that isPrivate (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16), never a public address or a name

LaunchPlan accepts a ws:// test relay only from a debug build's RELAYS command (src/debug, a local relay such as ws://10.0.2.2:7447); release builds always get the public wss:// relays whatever the choice (LaunchPlanTest); opens nothing

network_ok.reason: local Juggluco on this phone: the fixed loopback base URL (LOCAL_URL); no user-entered host
LibreView receiver-ID sign-in: https only, fixed host api.libreview.io or api-<region>.libreview.io (region validated as 2-3 lower-case letters)

Nostr sharing: relay WebSockets to the URLs RelayPool keeps through the launch's RelayAccess: release builds wss:// only (Wire.secureRelays); a debug build's RELAYS choice may add a local ws:// test relay (cleartext permitted only to 10.0.2.2 / loopback by the debug network security config)
About page update check: GET the fixed https URL api.github.com/repos/mauriciabad/sukrara/releases once per page open (no user-entered host, nothing sent)
Nightscout upload: the user-entered site, validated by NsSite.parse (https://, or http:// only to loopback); redirects are never followed and the token / secret never appears in a reason

LibreView upload: Abbott's fixed https config URL, then the https API address it names (every URL checked https, no user info); redirects are never followed; http only to loopback in tests (internal constructor flag)
xDrip+ server for Garmin watches: listens (never connects) on 127.0.0.1 only; bounded pool, request head and deadline; off by default
Tidepool upload: fixed https api.tidepool.org (tests: MockWebServer on loopback); redirects never followed; the session token never in logs or reasons
registers a ConnectivityManager callback to learn the Wi-Fi's address; opens no connection
Mac Juggluco on this network (opt-in): URLSessionLanHTTP's GETs and live stream; every URL is built by JugglucoApi.base (private IPv4 addresses only); tests use a fake LanHTTP
Mac relay WebSockets: RelayPool passes the protocol's wss:// relay list only
Mac update check: GET the fixed https URL of the GitHub releases API (no user-entered host, nothing sent)

permissions.android.permission.INTERNET: relays (wss), uploads (https), LibreView sign-in, Juggluco on loopback (:share, :sensor, :integrations)
permissions.android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE: reconnect when the network comes back; the Nightscout API serves only on Wi-Fi (:share, :integrations)
permissions.android.permission.ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK: Android 17: home-network devices may reach the opt-in Nightscout API (:integrations)
permissions.android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE: MonitoringService, the one monitoring service (:monitor; also androidx.work)
permissions.android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CO: MonitoringService type connectedDevice, not dataSync (capped at 6 h a day) (:monitor)
permissions.android.permission.CHANGE_NETWORK_STATE: the connectedDevice FGS prerequisite granted at install: a follower without Nearby devices still monitors (:monitor)
permissions.android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS: the glucose notification, alerts, reminders, access requests (:monitor)
permissions.android.permission.POST_PROMOTED_NOTIFIC: the Live Update chip and the sensor-end countdown (:monitor; verify-apk.sh requires it)
permissions.android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETE: monitoring and the alert check start again after a reboot (:monitor; also androidx.work)
permissions.android.permission.REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTER: the alert checklist's No battery restrictions: monitoring must not be killed (:monitor)
permissions.android.permission.USE_EXACT_ALARM: the alert check rings on time in Doze with the service dead (:monitor)
permissions.android.permission.USE_FULL_SCREEN_INTEN: the urgent-low alarm over the lock screen (:monitor)
permissions.android.permission.ACCESS_NOTIFICATION_P: Do Not Disturb access: alarm-level alerts override a mode that silences alarms (:monitor)
permissions.android.permission.WAKE_LOCK: androidx.work (the pen sync worker); Sukrara takes no wake lock itself
permissions.android.permission.READ_CALENDAR: sensor end in the calendar, opt-in (:monitor SensorCalendar)
permissions.android.permission.WRITE_CALENDAR: sensor end in the calendar, opt-in (:monitor SensorCalendar)
permissions.android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT: the sensor link and nearby sharing (:sensor, :share)
permissions.android.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN: finding a sensor and a wearer's phone nearby, neverForLocation (:sensor, :share)
permissions.android.permission.BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE: the wearer's phone offers nearby sharing (:share AndroidNearbyServer)
permissions.android.permission.CAMERA: scanning the invite QR on the join step (:feature:sharing ScanInvite)
permissions.android.permission.NFC: starting / taking over a Libre 3 and reading a pen with a tap (:sensor, :pen)
permissions.android.permission.health.WRITE_BLOOD_GL: Health Connect blood glucose, opt-in (:integrations PlatformHealth)
permissions.app.mauri.sukrara.permission.SYSTEMUI_ST: our own signature permission: only Sukrara feeds the System UI module (:monitor)
permissions.app.mauri.sukrara.DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_E: androidx.core's signature permission for ContextCompat.registerReceiver (not shown to the person)
